scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.docker:rebuild: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run docker:build && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml up --detach --wait --wait-timeout 120
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml logs --follow api db
scripts.docker:check: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml --profile tools run --build --rm tools
scripts.docker:logs:production: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yaml logs --follow api db
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml --profile tools --profile studio build api tools db-tools studio
scripts.db:push: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml --profile tools run --build --rm db-tools bun --bun run drizzle-kit push --config=drizzle.config.ts
scripts.db:push:production: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yaml --profile tools run --build --rm db-tools bun --bun run drizzle-kit push --config=drizzle.config.ts
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f compose.test.yaml up --build --attach integration --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from integration
